# TUTORERA

> TUTORERA is a Pakistan-based online and in-person tutoring marketplace operated by MENTISERA (SMC-Private) Limited.

Canonical website: https://tutorera.ac.pk/

Students and parents can find verified tutors by subject, academic level, city, teaching mode, hourly rate, schedule, and rating.

Important pages:
- https://tutorera.ac.pk/tutors
- https://tutorera.ac.pk/subjects
- https://tutorera.ac.pk/levels
- https://tutorera.ac.pk/how-it-works
- https://tutorera.ac.pk/pricing
- https://tutorera.ac.pk/safety-policy
- https://tutorera.ac.pk/about
- https://tutorera.ac.pk/contact
